h1: A code audit that shows what to fix and in what order
overview: We read your code the way a new senior developer would. We look at how it is organized, how data is handled, what dependencies are out of date, where the security gaps are, how fast it runs and how well it is tested. You receive a written report that ranks each finding by risk and effort, with the file and line it refers to, and plain advice. A call to talk it through is optional.

faq: Will you fix what you find?
The audit is a report. You can give it to your own developers, or order a feature work or support package from us for the items you choose.
Do I have to share my whole codebase?
We need read access to the repository. We can work under a simple confidentiality agreement if you wish, and we remove our access when the audit is done.
Is this a security penetration test?
No. We look for common coding risks and weak settings. A formal penetration test is a specialist job and is not covered here. We say clearly what we did and did not check.
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python and PHP are our usual ones. Send us the repository link and we confirm before you order.
